units.source_text: 父亲一边看通往出售房子那家的路线图，一边往左拐弯。

en.t: Father turned left while looking at the route map to the house that was for sale.

units.source_text: 那家的房子看上去确实很窄小，它坐落在高高的土围墙深处。

en.t: The house did indeed look very small and narrow, standing deep inside a high earthen wall.

units.source_text: 从窄小的便门走到大门，道路两旁绽开了一长溜胡枝子白花。

en.t: From the narrow side gate to the main gate, a long row of white bush clover flowers bloomed on both sides of the path.
